description: Minified Bootstrap v3.3.5 JavaScript library, including core components such as alerts, buttons, carousel, collapse, dropdown, modal, tooltip, popover, scrollspy, tabs, and affix. The file is a compressed version of Bootstrap's JavaScript code, containing implementation of various UI interactions.

methods.name: emulateTransitionEnd

methods.name: carousel
methods.description: Controls carousel sliding and cycling behavior.

methods.name: dropdown
methods.description: Manages dropdown menu toggle and keyboard navigation.

methods.name: modal
methods.description: Implements modal window display, hide, backdrop, and focus management.

methods.name: scrollspy
methods.description: Monitors scrolling to update navigation state.

methods.name: affix
methods.description: Implements sticky element positioning based on scroll.
